question: Which of the following Indian stadium is renowned as a major venue for hockey matches?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kalinga Stadium**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, is one of the premier sports venues in India, particularly known for its association with field hockey.
 
• Kalinga Stadium has a rich history of hosting significant international and national hockey tournaments.
 
• It is considered one of the best-equipped hockey venues in the country.
 
• It was the host of the **2018 Men's Hockey World Cup**, one of the sport's most prestigious tournaments,
 
 
• and has also hosted multiple **Hockey Pro League** matches and other international competitions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chinnaswamy Stadium (Bangalore)**:

 
 
• This stadium is primarily known for cricket, not hockey.
 
• It is the home ground of the Karnataka state team and the Royal Challengers Bangalore IPL franchise.
 
• The M. Chinnaswamy Stadium is one of India's most iconic cricket venues
 
 
 
• **M. A. Chidambaram Stadium (Chennai)**:
 
 
• Like Chinnaswamy, M. A. Chidambaram Stadium, also known as Chepauk Stadium, is primarily a cricket stadium.
 
• It is one of the oldest and most famous cricket venues in India, hosting many international matches, including the Indian Premier League (IPL)
 
 
 
• **Wankhede Stadium (Mumbai)**:
 
 
• Wankhede Stadium is another prominent cricket venue in India, located in Mumbai.
 
• It is best known for hosting the 2011 Cricket World Cup Final, where India emerged as champions.
